dequantize_k_cache: dequantize a float8 k-cache tensor to bfloat16 using the fast Triton-based dequantization kernel
dequantize_k_cache_paged: dequantize a paged float8 k-cache tensor to bfloat16 using page table indices for scattered token layout
dequantize_k_cache_ref: dequantize a float8 k-cache tensor to bfloat16 using a reference PyTorch implementation with scale multiplication
_dequantize_k_cache_fast: dequantize a flattened float8 k-cache tensor to bfloat16 using a Triton kernel with grouped scaling
_dequantize_k_cache_fast_kernel: run a Triton JIT kernel that dequantizes nope blocks by scale multiplication and copies rope blocks to bfloat16 output
